narr: Showers and thunderstorm developed north of a warm front during the morning hours on Friday (7/15) across portions of central Wisconsin. A total of 2 to 4 inches of rain fell in a short period across Wood County, causing flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced 2 to 4 inches of rain during the early morning hours, causing flooding across portions of Wood County.
lsr: SOME INTERSECTIONS REPORTED KNEE-DEEP WATER IN RICHFIELD TOWNSHIP. IN ADDITION, THERE WAS MINOR FLOODING AT NORTHWOOD COUNTY PARK.
